description: This Java source file defines the ModuleIndexes class, which provides functionalities for mapping module names to their associated make files and vice versa by reading and processing an index file.

classes.name: ModuleIndexes
classes.description: Provides mapping between module names and make files by reading an index file and offering lookup methods.

methods.name: ModuleIndexes
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the index with the given index file.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Reads the index file to build internal maps between modules and make files.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a module and its make file to the internal mappings.

methods.name: getMakeFile
methods.description: Retrieves the make file associated with a given module name.
